item.title: Pakistan Banks Association Elects Zafar Masud as Chairman and Constitutes 16-Member Executive Committee
item.description: The Pakistan Banks Association (PBA) elected and constituted a new 16-member Executive Committee, including two female members and eight newly inducted member banks, marking a strategic shift toward greater inclusivity and broader industry representation.
